agentic.name: Agentic
agentic.description: Conversational AI-first interface with minimal controls, clear outcomes, and delegated task flows for agentic workflows.
agentic.use: produtos de IA/chat em que o usuário delega tarefas.

ant.name: Ant
ant.description: Structured, enterprise-focused design system emphasizing clarity, consistency, and efficiency for data-dense web applications.

artistic.name: Artistic
artistic.description: High-contrast, expressive style with creative typography and bold color choices for visually striking interfaces.

basic.name: Basic
basic.description: Print-inspired visual language for books, magazines, and reports with editorial grids and expressive typography.

bento.name: Bento
bento.description: Modular grid layout with card-like blocks, clear hierarchy, soft spacing, and subtle visual contrast for organized, scannable interfaces.
bento.use: páginas de produto, features e dashboards leves.

bold.name: Bold
bold.description: Strong visual presence with heavyweight typography, high-contrast colors, and commanding layouts.
bold.use: marcas que precisam de impacto imediato.

brutalism.name: Brutalism
brutalism.description: Raw, anti-design aesthetic inspired by concrete architecture with unadorned elements, jarring layouts, and functional minimalism.

cafe.name: Cafe
cafe.description: Cozy cafe-inspired interface with warm tones, soft typography, and clean layouts for a relaxed browsing experience.

claude.name: Claude
claude.description: A research-journal aesthetic printed on warm stone — authoritative, editorial, almost achromatic. Pages live on warm ivory parchment (never pure white), with near-black slate as the dominant ink.
claude.use: produtos de leitura, reflexão e IA editorial.

claymorphism.name: Claymorphism
claymorphism.description: Soft, rounded 3D-like shapes mimicking malleable clay with playful, puffy elements and colorful surfaces.

clean.name: Clean
clean.description: Simplicity-focused design with ample whitespace, legible typography, and a limited color palette to reduce visual clutter.
clean.use: SaaS, documentação e produtos que precisam de clareza.

codex.name: Open
codex.description: A radically minimal, blank-canvas interface built as a pure edge-to-edge surface, with almost no color and typography carrying the visual weight. Black serves as the only filled color, the only divider, and the sole surface tone cards.

colorful.name: Colorful
colorful.description: Vibrant, high-contrast palettes and gradients for engaging, memorable, and modern user experiences.

contemporary.name: Contemporary
contemporary.description: Current-era minimalist design with bento grids, dark mode support, and high-performance accessible layouts.

corporate.name: Corporate
corporate.description: Professional, brand-aligned design with structured grids, minimalist layouts, and consistent enterprise patterns.

cosmic.name: Cosmic
cosmic.description: Futuristic sci-fi aesthetic with dark themes, vibrant neon accents, and immersive spatial elements.

creative.name: Creative
creative.description: Playful, character-driven design with expressive typography and bold graphics for landing pages and creative projects.

dithered.name: Dithered
dithered.description: Dot-pattern rendering technique that simulates shades with a limited palette for nostalgic, retro, high-contrast visuals.

doodle.name: Doodle
doodle.description: Hand-drawn, sketch-like style with doodles, handwritten fonts, and imperfect lines for a playful, informal feel.

dramatic.name: Dramatic
dramatic.description: High-contrast, theatrical design with bold layouts, immersive visuals, and unconventional compositions that command attention.

editorial.name: Editorial
editorial.description: Magazine-inspired editorial layout with refined serif typography, structured grids, and elegant reading experiences.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: Dark-themed cloud-platform aesthetic with modular grids, glass-like panels, and strong data hierarchy for productivity dashboards.
enterprise.visual: modern, clean, cloud-platform aesthetic (Heroku/Vercel/GitHub inspired), dark theme, subtle gradients, soft shadows, glass-like panels, rounded components

expressive.name: Expressive
expressive.description: Vibrant, personality-driven design with bold colors, playful graphics, and dynamic layouts that balance creativity with structure.

fantasy.name: Fantasy
fantasy.description: Game-inspired fantasy aesthetic with bold, premium visuals, rich color palettes, and immersive thematic elements.

fiction.name: Fiction
fiction.description: A playful, energetic, cartoonesque interface inspired by friendly children's-book illustrations — warm cream backgrounds, big bold custom display typography, saturated brand color blocks, thick black outlines, generously rounded shapes

flat.name: Flat
flat.description: Two-dimensional minimalist style with vibrant colors, clean typography, and no 3D effects for fast, user-friendly interfaces.
flat.use: apps de massa que priorizam performance.

friendly.name: Friendly
friendly.description: Approachable, intuitive design with rounded elements, ample whitespace, and soft pastel color palettes.

futuristic.name: Futuristic
futuristic.description: Forward-looking design with tech-inspired typography, modern layouts, and a sleek, innovation-driven aesthetic.

geometric.name: Geometric
geometric.description: Geometric, structured design with clean typography, neutral colors, precise shapes, and intuitive layouts that stay out of the way.
geometric.use: ferramentas profissionais que não devem chamar atenção.

glassmorphism.name: Glassmorphism
glassmorphism.description: Frosted glass effect with translucent layers, subtle blur, and luminous borders for depth and modern elegance.
glassmorphism.visual: clean, high-contrast, bold, enterprise, liquidglass effect, glassmorphism

gradient.name: Gradient
gradient.description: Smooth color transitions and gradient-rich surfaces for modern, playful interfaces with visual depth.

high-end-visual-design.name: high-end-visual-design
high-end-visual-design.description: Look calmo e polido de agência high-end: contraste suave, whitespace generoso, motion por springs, micro-interações hápticas (double-bezel), com arquétipos de vibe e layout sorteados por projeto (Ethereal Glass, Editorial Luxury, Soft Structuralism; bento assimétrico, cascata Z, split editorial).
high-end-visual-design.use: somente quando chamada pelo nome, para experiências premium nível Awwwards sem agressividade.
high-end-visual-design.avoid: em densidade extrema de dados ou marcas rústicas/energéticas.

immersive.name: Immersive
immersive.description: An immersive, interactive, exhibit-style interface that blends storytelling, animation, and gamified elements to create a playful, experience-driven journey. The entire app sits on a single continuous brand-colored canvas (deep green)

impeccable.name: Impeccable
impeccable.description: A modern, graphic, editorial-poster aesthetic — warm and confident — built on alternating cream and burnt orange sections, an amber brand color.

industrial-brutalist-ui.name: industrial-brutalist-ui
industrial-brutalist-ui.description: Look mecânico duro: tipografia suíça, grids rígidos, contraste extremo de escala e cor utilitária. Dois arquétipos — Swiss Industrial Print (claro, impresso) OU Tactical Telemetry/CRT (escuro, terminal militar) — escolher UM e não misturar no mesmo projeto.
industrial-brutalist-ui.use: somente quando chamada pelo nome, para looks industriais, técnicos ou militares.
industrial-brutalist-ui.avoid: em produtos consumer amigáveis; não alternar os dois arquétipos no mesmo projeto.

levels.name: Levels
levels.description: Conversion-focused design that removes friction and guides users toward action through clarity, trust, and speed.
levels.use: landing pages e funis de conversão.

lingo.name: Lingo
lingo.description: Playful, minimal design with bright colors, rounded shapes, tactile 3D borders, and friendly illustrations for approachable interfaces.

material.name: Material
material.description: Google's Material Design with layered surfaces, dynamic theming, built-in motion, and responsive cross-platform patterns.

matrix.name: Matrix
matrix.description: A cyber-slick, dark-only Matrix-inspired interface defined by minimalist fashion, high-tech digital elements
matrix.use: tech e projetos temáticos do filme.

minimal.name: Minimal Design
minimal.description: Stripped-back design emphasizing whitespace, clean typography, and restrained color for maximum clarity and focus.

minimalist-ui.name: minimalist-ui
minimalist-ui.description: UI editorial de produto "documento": monocromia quente, contraste tipográfico extremo (serifa editorial + sans + mono), grids bento ultra-flat, pastéis dessaturados pontuais. Proíbe Inter/Roboto, ícones genéricos de traço grosso, sombras duras, gradientes, pills grandes e emojis.
minimalist-ui.use: somente quando chamada pelo nome, para look de workspace premium utilitário.
minimalist-ui.avoid: em marcas coloridas, lúdicas ou com fotografia rica.

modern.name: Modern
modern.description: Contemporary editorial style with serif typography, minimal palettes, and clean layouts for polished digital products.

mono.name: Mono design
mono.description: Monospace-driven, matrix-inspired design with high-contrast elements, compact density, and a hacker-chic aesthetic.

neobrutalism.name: Neobrutalism
neobrutalism.description: Modern take on brutalism with bold borders, vivid accent colors, and raw, high-contrast layouts on warm surfaces.

neon.name: Neon
neon.description: Electric neon glow effects with high-contrast color pairings for bold, attention-grabbing interfaces.

neumorphism.name: Neumorphism club
neumorphism.description: Soft, extruded UI elements with inner and outer shadows on monochromatic surfaces for a tactile, embedded look.

pacman.name: Pacman
pacman.description: Retro arcade-inspired design with pixel fonts, dotted borders, playful high-contrast colors, and 8-bit game aesthetics.

paper.name: Paper Design
paper.description: Paper-textured, print-inspired design with minimal colors, clean serif/sans typography, and tactile surface qualities.

perspective.name: Perspective Design
perspective.description: Spatial depth design with isometric views, vanishing points, and layered elements that guide attention through 3D-like realism.

power.name: Power
power.description: High-end dark aesthetic with bold headings, monochromatic palette, and premium feel for premium brand experiences.

premium.name: Premium
premium.description: Apple-inspired premium aesthetic with precise spacing, modern typography, and a refined, polished visual language.

professional.name: Professional
professional.description: Polished, business-ready design with modern typography, structured layouts, and a trustworthy visual identity.

pulse.name: Pulse
pulse.description: Dynamic, vibrant style with thick borders, geometric shapes, high-contrast colors, and expressive typography conveying motion and vitality.

refined.name: Refined
refined.description: Carefully curated, modern minimal style with elegant serif typography and understated, sophisticated palettes.

retro.name: Retro
retro.description: Throwback design with vintage-inspired typography, high-contrast retro palettes, and nostalgic visual elements.

riso.name: Riso
riso.description: A playful, joyful, two-color risograph print aesthetic built on a single warm off-white paper surface running through every section

roku.name: Roku
roku.description: App dashboard with purple-themed aesthetic, top-bar navigation, card-based layouts, and developer-first workflows.
roku.visual: modern, clean, high-contrast, glass-like panels, soft shadows, rounded components

sega.name: Sega
sega.description: A playful, arcade-inspired interface for games — built on the VT323 pixel typeface, hard-edged 0px corners, chunky pill buttons that physically press into solid offset blocks

shadcn.name: Shadcn
shadcn.description: Shadcn/ui-inspired design with minimal, clean components, monochrome palette, and utility-first patterns.

sketch.name: Sketch
sketch.description: A friendly, hand-drawn sketch interface inspired by pencil illustrations on warm cream paper. Soft teal brand accents, hand-written display headings, rounded pill controls.
sketch.use: produtos amigáveis em fase de ideação.

skeumorphism.name: Skeumorphism
skeumorphism.description: Real-world mimicry with textured surfaces, 3D effects, and familiar physical metaphors for intuitive digital interfaces.
skeumorphism.use: apps para leigos e nostalgia pré-2013.

sleek.name: Sleek
sleek.description: Modern minimalist aesthetic with clean lines, intentional color palette, subtle interactions, and consistent spacing.

spacious.name: Spacious
spacious.description: Generous whitespace, consistent padding, and grid-based layouts for clean, readable, and breathing interfaces.

square.name: Square
square.description: Graceful, refined aesthetic with delicate typography, minimal palettes, and polished layouts that exude sophistication.

stitch.name: Stitch
stitch.description: Clean, high-contrast enterprise design for data-driven workflows with intuitive drag-and-drop patterns and structured layouts.

storytelling.name: Storytelling
storytelling.description: Narrative-driven design using visuals, copy, and interaction to guide users through engaging, emotionally resonant journeys.

terracotta.name: Terracotta
terracotta.description: A sun-baked, clay-toned editorial interface built on warm cream surfaces, ink-brown headlines set in a display serif, and a single terracotta accent.

tetris.name: Tetris
tetris.description: Classic block-game inspired design with playful colors, bold display fonts, and compact, high-energy layouts.

vibrant.name: Vibrant
vibrant.description: Lively, colorful design with bold playful typography, warm accents, and dynamic visual energy.

vintage.name: Vintage
vintage.description: 1950s-1990s nostalgia with skeuomorphic touches, grainy textures, retro color palettes, and pixel-style typography.
